jobs.title: Cribl: Sr. UX Designer, Security
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: https://cribl.io/

Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to help define and deliver Cribl security product experience. You will design for security practitioners across detection, alerting, investigation, triage, search, threat coverage, telemetry, and AI-assisted workflows.

This role requires a genuine security background and the ability to turn complex SOC workflows into clear, trustworthy experiences. You will partner with Product, Engineering, UX Research, and other designers to create a cohesive experience that works seamlessly with our other products across the entire Cribl platform.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

  • Lead end-to-end design from problem framing and research through interaction design, prototyping, validation, and implementation.
  • Design workflows for detection creation and management, alert review, investigation, triage, search pivots, threat coverage, normalization, and enrichment.
  • Apply security judgment to evidence, provenance, confidence, severity, permissions, auditability, destructive actions, and operational risk.
  • Design AI-assisted and agentic experiences that make intent, context, sources, capabilities, uncertainty, and user approval clear.
  • Use Cribl’s design system and contribute reusable components, patterns, guidance, and interaction models when the work has broader value.
  • Work expertly in Figma for exploration, prototyping, documentation, collaboration, and handoff, including libraries, variables, components, variants, and tokens.
  • Partner with engineers, PMs and designers through ideation, development to support feasibility, accessibility, resilience, and high-fidelity implementation challenges.
  • Share work early and often through critiques and working sessions. Give and receive specific, constructive feedback.
  • Use research and product evidence to prioritize opportunities, evaluate concepts, and improve shipped workflows.
  • Communicate design rationale, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
  • We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones - you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours.


If You’ve Got It - We Want It

  • Required:
    • 5+ years experience designing complex B2B software, enterprise platforms, or products for technical users.
    • A security background, such as security product design, security operations, threat detection, incident response, threat hunting, detection engineering, SOC workflows, SIEM, EDR, SOAR, or a related discipline.
    • Understanding of security practitioners’ realities, including noisy signals, incomplete evidence, time pressure, and high-consequence decisions.
    • Strong product thinking and interaction-design skills, with the ability to make complex technical workflows simple without oversimplifying them.
    • Experience designing AI-assisted, agentic, conversational, or other emerging interaction models.
    • Expert Figma skills, including advanced prototyping and design documentation.
    • Demonstrated expertise working in and contributing to design systems. You know when to use existing patterns and when to extend them thoughtfully.
    • Understanding of AI tools and AI UX interaction models is required. You can design experiences where AI assists, recommends, generates, investigates, or takes action while preserving user understanding, control, and trust.
    • Experience collaborating closely with Product and Engineering in an iterative and changing environment.
    • Strong communication, facilitation, and problem solving skills, including the ability to make progress when information is incomplete.
    • A portfolio with case studies that show your role, process, decisions, collaboration, and outcomes. Candidates will be asked to present and discuss previous work.
  • Highly desired:
    • Familiarity with research tools such as Dovetail, including transcripts, tagging, themes, repositories, and insights.
    • Experience with security data, detections, alerts, investigations, threat intelligence, telemetry, data pipelines, or analytical workflows.
    • Experience designing for roles, permissions, tenants, environments, or different levels of technical expertise.
  • A plus
    • Understanding of accessible product design and inclusive interaction practices.
    • Familiarity with WCAG principles, keyboard interactions, focus management, semantic structure, color contrast, and accessible content patterns.
    • Familiarity with OCSF, MITRE ATT&CK, KQL, Sigma, detection rules, threat intelligence, or related concepts.

jobs.title: Cambridge Information Group Inc: Front-End Developer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: New York, NY
URL: https://edconic.com/

Job Title: Front-End Developer
Location: Fully Remote (US)
Department: Global Enrollment Marketing and Sales
Reports to: Director of Web Development
Classification: Regular, Full-time
FLSA Status: Exempt
Prepared by: Global Head of Creative
Prepared Date: 10/1/26
Salary range: $85,000–$100,000


About Edconic

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property – from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.
  • Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.
  • Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.
  • Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.
  • Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.
  • The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.
  • Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.
  • Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.
  • A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.
  • Experience building and testing HTML emails.
  • Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.
  • A proactive, self-directed working style – you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication – you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.

Bonus Experience

  • Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns.
  • Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
  • Deeper accessibility experience (WCAG, ARIA, assistive-technology testing).
  • CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement).
  • Multilingual WordPress sites.
  • A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue.
  • UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.


How We Use AI

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.

Location, Travel & Eligibility

  • Fully remote within the United States. Occasional travel to our New York office may be required.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the US.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred (Computer Science, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Communications, or a related field); equivalent professional experience is equally welcome.

Our Commitment

Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role and to participate in the interview process.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work for this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills. Edconic reserves the right to modify this job description at its sole discretion.

jobs.title: SimpleTiger: Web Developer: WordPress & HubSpot (U.S. Based, Remote Contractor)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Sarasota, FL
URL: https://www.simpletiger.com/

SimpleTiger is hiring a part-time contract web developer to build, improve, and troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot, with the potential to grow into a larger role.

We’re a B2B SaaS marketing agency helping software companies grow through SEO, content marketing, paid media, and answer engine optimization (AEO). Our clients’ websites are where much of that work comes to life, and we’re looking for a developer who can turn ideas into clean, functional pages quickly.

As part of our delivery team, you’ll work primarily on client websites, translating designs, campaign concepts, and SEO recommendations into effective web experiences. From building new pages to fixing issues on existing sites, you’ll help turn our marketing strategy into work that’s ready to launch.

Key responsibilities

  • Build, update, or troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot CMS
  • Make technical fixes and improvements to live client sites, with clear details on what was tested, implemented, and performance comparisons using tools like Screaming Frog, pagespeed insights, and Lighthouse
  • Build and connect forms, lead routing, and simple automations between a site and the client’s marketing tools
  • Set up and check tracking, like GA4, Google Tag Manager, and HubSpot tracking in Tandem with the SEO Manager
  • Keep sites fast, accessible, and friendly to SEO (page speed, Core Web Vitals, clean markup, image optimizations, cache lifetime improvements, and so on)
  • Write clear and timely notes on what you are actively working on, and any updates pushed live so our team and the client can follow along

Qualifications and skills

  • You’re a hands-on developer who can build from scratch, troubleshoot existing sites, and make improvements without disrupting what’s already working.

Required skills

  • WordPress development: Strong experience with custom themes, child themes, blocks, page builders, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF). You can build a page from the ground up—not just edit an existing one.
  • HubSpot CMS development: Strong experience with HubL templates, modules, and themes, including building and troubleshooting pages, forms, and email templates.
  • Front-end development: Solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills, with the ability to navigate existing code and understand how changes affect the live site.
  • APIs and integrations: Experience working with the HubSpot or WordPress REST APIs, plus CRMs and marketing tools such as Salesforce, Zapier, n8n, Airtable, and Slack.
  • Technical audits and fixes: Experience using Screaming Frog to audit WordPress and HubSpot sites, interpret findings, and resolve technical issues.
  • Code review and cleanup: Comfort working within WordPress and HubSpot codebases to identify legacy or unused JavaScript and CSS, determine what’s still needed, and safely remove what isn’t.
  • Async communication: Clear, timely written communication, especially through Slack.
  • Independent work: Strong time management and the ability to meet deadlines, flag blockers early, and keep projects moving without close supervision.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Webflow development and auditing experience, including building a clean CMS structure.
  • PHP development experience.
  • Previous work at a marketing agency or with B2B SaaS clients.
  • Familiarity with SEO and conversion best practices.
  • Experience with Git and version control.

What success looks like

Success means delivering clean, reliable development work that helps our team turn marketing plans into live client experiences.

  • Designs, campaign concepts, and SEO requests become functional pages in WordPress and HubSpot.
  • Technical audit findings lead to practical fixes, with changes tested to avoid breaking existing functionality.
  • Legacy and unused code is cleaned up thoughtfully, while essential code and front-end behavior remain intact.
  • Forms, templates, and integrations work as intended and support the client’s marketing workflows.
  • Projects stay on track because you manage your workload, meet agreed deadlines, and raise questions or blockers early.
  • Teammates have clear visibility into progress through timely updates and straightforward communication in Slack.

jobs.title: DuckDuckGo: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Paoli, Pennsylvania
URL: https://duckduckgo.com

Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.

 

Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

 

Your Team and Role

Working on the Backend Functional Team, you'll lead complex projects across key company-wide objectives. Using Perl (Version 5), Go, and Node.js, you’ll write pragmatic, performant, testable code that works consistently, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

  • Implementing AI-assisted answers and integrating them into our Search product while maintaining our privacy-first approach

  • Delivering improvements to Duck.ai to help us make it a competitive AI chat alternative for both free and paying users

  • Implementing sophisticated data processing pipelines that maintain search relevancy

 

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll collaborate remotely with your peers and take responsibility for solving product issues impacting our all-in-one privacy solution, whether large or small. In time, you'll formally mentor other engineers, supporting their career growth and the growth of the Backend Team at DuckDuckGo.

 

About You

  • 7+ years of professional experience, primarily focused on backend systems that power consumer-facing products

  • Product acumen to reason about technical tradeoffs in terms of user impact

  • Familiarity with AI agent tooling: evaluation frameworks, RAG pipelines and prompt engineering

  • A fundamental understanding of complex data structures and algorithms — you can develop and apply new solutions and confidently navigate and improve existing code.

  • Data-driven analytical skills for decision-making, stakeholder alignment, and experiment-oriented delivery

  • Solid project management abilities

  • Excellent written and verbal communication to validate and articulate decisions

  • Previous experience leading and mentoring experienced engineers, supporting their career goals, and unlocking their potential.

 

Compensation

This role is paid on a regional pay scale, in local currency, and stock options:

  • United States: $190,500 USD annually

  • United Kingdom: £134,600 GBP annually

  • Canada: C$253,500 CAD annually

  • Europe/Rest of World: €157,350 EUR annually

In Spain, pay is expected to transition to the EUR scale on January 1, 2027, and in other Europe/Rest of World countries on February 1, 2027.

 

Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

 

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

 

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

 

 

Hiring Process

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

 

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to careers@duckduckgo.com to let us know the nature of your request.

 

Please note that:

  • You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

  • Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

  • While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

  • A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

  • By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

 

Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

Key Principles:

  • Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy. We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.

  • Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

  • Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at careers@duckduckgo.com. Thank you for your interest in joining DuckDuckGo!

jobs.title: Contra: Senior 3D Designer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA
URL: http://bit.ly/3kLhMdk

About Contra Labs

Contra Labs sits at the intersection of human creativity and AI. We partner with leading AI labs and product companies to improve their tools across design, video, development, and beyond. Our research is grounded in how top creatives actually work, studying the patterns behind what gets created, what gets chosen, and what resonates. We believe human input will always be at the center of net new creation, and our mission is to help shape technology so human creativity can be amplified to create what today is unimaginable.

By joining the Contra Labs network you gain access to paid projects with some of the most innovative companies building the next generation of creative and AI-powered tools.

How It Works

This is an application to join the network and be eligible for roles as they arise. Projects are staffed on an as-needed basis, typically 5 to 10 hours at a time, though some may extend into longer engagements. In unique cases, we may have full-time roles available as well. When a project matches your skill set, we'll reach out with details and timeline.

To Join the Network

  • Portfolio review - We'll assess your Contra profile and portfolio for strength in content design, with a focus on ad creative and performance-driven visual content.

  • Record a 30 second intro video - Share a quick 30 second introduction so we can get to know you.

  • Complete profile - Once you’ve applied, we recommend completing your profile for better job matches and setting up your wallet so you can get paid when a job comes through.

What You May Work On

  • Evaluate AI-generated 3D scenes, interactive environments, simulations, and spatial experiences for visual and technical quality

  • Provide clear, structured feedback on scene composition, lighting, materials, physical dynamics, asset integration, interaction, and overall visual coherence

  • Help define quality benchmarks and evaluation criteria for what great AI-generated 3D experiences should look and feel like

  • Identify common failure modes in AI-generated 3D work, from broken physics and interactions to poor spatial composition or inconsistent visual feedback

  • Create reference examples, prototypes, or "golden" outputs that demonstrate best-in-class 3D execution

  • Contribute to research exploring how AI models can better understand and generate interactive 3D experiences

What We're Looking For

  • Strong portfolio showcasing high-quality 3D design, interactive environments, or spatial experiences

  • Strong understanding of 3D composition, lighting, materials, animation, and visual coherence

  • Ability to articulate creative and technical feedback clearly and constructively

  • Strong 3D design instincts and awareness of contemporary visual culture, 3D trends, and emerging digital aesthetics

  • Comfort working in fast-paced, experimental environments (experience with AI, 3D tools, or creative technology is a plus)

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/contra-senior-3d-designer

jobs.title: Zanda Health: Product Owner
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Australia
URL: https://zandahealth.com/eu/

Product Owner

Remote | Permanent Contractor | Core EU Collaboration Hours
Reports to: Product Manager

Are you a product driven problem solver who enjoys turning customer insight into things that actually get built? Do you love turning complexity into clarity, aligning teams, and shaping product experiences that genuinely make people’s lives easier? If so, we’d love to meet you!

We build software that takes the stress, chaos, and friction out of managing a health practice. As our newest Product Owner, you’ll play a pivotal role in translating vision into action, turning customer needs into features and driving product outcomes that truly matter.

You’re someone on the rise - intelligent, opinionated (in the best way), and ready to make an impact. You’re not easily swayed, and you’re happy to take a stand when it serves the customer and the product. You connect dots, ask great questions, and care deeply about delivering value. If that sounds like you… read on!

You’re Excited To

  • Be the voice of the customer; advocate for user needs and pain points.

  • Maintain deep customer understanding and share insights with key teams.

  • Translate product priorities into clear, prioritised & actionable items for your team

  • Work closely with engineering to understand constraints, dependencies, and system behaviour

  • Build alignment, trust and collaborate seamlessly across Product, Engineering, and Customer Support

  • Ensure continuous delivery of value; own the lifecycle from discovery to post-launch iteration.

  • Guide product decisions that make a real difference for the people using Zanda every day

  • Communicate clearly across async and real-time channels.

  • Surface risks early and drive grounded, data-informed decisions.

  • Contribute to risk-based analysis of product changes and support identification of potential vulnerabilities


What You Bring to the Team

Experience 

  • 2+ years of hands-on product ownership experience (SaaS experience an asset)

  • Proven ability to translate customer pains into clear requirements and impactful improvements

  • Strong understanding of agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and product development architecture

  • Experience in another role before moving into product - a Customer Success, Support, or similar background is a real plus

  • Demonstrated experience working with remote, cross-cultural teams across multiple time zones

Skills 

  • Customer Insight & Discovery - understands user needs, pain points, and motivations.

  • Strategic Thinking -  connects decisions in your product area to customer needs and team priorities

  • Data-Informed Decision Making - uses data to guide choices, even with ambiguity.

  • Clear & Adaptive Communication - complex to simple, and with the audience in mind. 

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration -  works effectively across teams and builds influence through trust, not title.

  • Prioritisation - confidently prioritises what drives the most impact and eliminates noise.

  • Technical Fluency - understands enough to engage meaningfully with engineering.

  • Risk Identification & Mitigation - surfaces risks early and makes grounded decisions.

  • Problem Solving & Critical Thinking - breaks down complexity into clear, actionable steps.

Traits 

  • High Ownership Mindset - proactive and treats the product like a business.

  • Collaborative & Empathetic - builds trust quickly and embraces diverse perspectives.

  • Calm Under Pressure - steady when navigating competing priorities or ambiguity.

  • Adaptable & Curious - thrives in fast-changing environments, shows interest in emerging technologies - particularly AI and automation.

  • Integrity-Driven - transparent, reliable, and grounded in facts, not ego.

  • Opinionated (in the right ways) – advocates confidently for what's right for the customer, and isn't easily swayed.

  • Energetic & Self-Starter - brings momentum, enthusiasm, and a bias for action.

  • Strategic Yet Practical - able to zoom out and zoom in fluidly.

  • Growth Oriented - desire to grow, stretch, take on more responsibility, and help influence direction.

  • Customer-Obsessed - curious, empathetic, and motivated to solve real user problems.

                            

 

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

✅ Work from Anywhere
We’ve been a fully distributed team from the start - no offices, no commute, just great people from all over the world doing meaningful work together.
✅ Flexibility & Autonomy

jobs.title: Knack: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: US
URL: https://knack.com

Location: US Based (Full-Time, Remote) or International Contractor (Full-Time, Remote)

If US-Based:
This will be a remote position based in the United States. Knack offers a complete benefits package to those working in the United States. Employees must be available during standard US business hours and maintain their primary work location within the US. Any extended time working outside the United States requires prior written approval.

International Contractor:
This is a full-time, remote position, but candidates must have four hours overlap with Eastern timezone.

Role Overview

Knack runs thousands of customer applications across multiple global regions, including dedicated private environments. As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll own and evolve that infrastructure, harden it to meet SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security requirements, and build the infrastructure behind our growing AI capabilities.

We’re an AI-forward team. You don’t need to type every Terraform block, but you do need to understand what’s happening, direct AI tools well, verify their work, and own the outcome. This role includes a weekly 24/7 on-call rotation.

About Knack

Knack is an AI-powered no-code software development platform enabling organizations to manage, analyze, and share business data. The no-code market is growing at over 30% annually and projected to be almost $200B by 2030. Founded in 2010, Knack has grown into a leading player in the no-code movement, enabling businesses, teams, and individuals to build custom applications without writing a single line of code.

Serving a wide range of industries, from healthcare and education to finance and nonprofits, and organizations from small businesses to Fortune 500s, Knack enables users to boost data visibility and streamline operations.

To date, the platform has powered 400,000 apps and stored more than 5 billion data records for over 15,000 customers. Its enterprise-grade functionality includes an AI-powered visual builder, robust data structures, user access controls, and automation capabilities, all delivered by a fully remote team committed to trust, continuous improvement, and measurable impact.

 

Key Responsibilities

Run AWS infrastructure as code, with AI in the loop

  • Manage AWS infrastructure through Terraform using our pull-request-based GitOps workflow, and resolve configuration drift across regions.
  • Use AI tools to draft, review, and explain Terraform changes, then verify every plan before it merges. You own every change you approve, regardless of who or what wrote it.
  • Maintain reusable modules and the standards that make AI-generated changes safe and consistent.

Make AWS and Claude work together

  • Help design and operate how AI assistants work with our AWS environments, for investigation, analysis, incident triage, and infrastructure changes.
  • Define the IAM roles, permission boundaries, logging, and approval gates that govern what AI tools can see and do.
  • Evaluate AI access for blast radius and auditability.

Implement security controls with our security lead

  • Enforce encryption at rest and TLS in transit, tighten IAM and S3 permissions, manage WAF rules and security headers, and rotate secrets.
  • Drive pentest and audit findings to verified fixes in every environment.
  • Secure the AI tooling itself, including agent credentials, secrets handling, MCP server exposure, and prompt injection risk.

Support compliance and audits

  • Configure and maintain SOC 2 and HIPAA controls such as log retention, alarms, VPC flow logs, and backups.
  • Ensure AI-assisted changes keep the same review, approval, and audit trail as any other change.
  • Gather audit evidence and help maintain security tooling.

Build monitoring, alerting, and runbooks

  • Create dashboards and monitors that catch issues before customers do, and tune noisy alerts.
  • Keep runbooks current and written so that both people and AI assistants can follow them.

Keep systems patched and current

  • Lead OS upgrades, runtime and end-of-life migrations, dependency updates, and certificate renewals.

Operate and scale databases and customer environments

  • Tune, resize, and secure databases on multiple platforms.
  • Provision or decommission dedicated customer servers for Sales and Support.

Resolve escalations and automate repeat work

  • Troubleshoot production issues for Support, Sales, and Engineering.
  • Replace recurring manual tasks with automation, CI/CD improvements, or self-service tooling, using AI to move faster while verifying what it produces.

Participate in on-call

  • Participate in our weekly 24/7 on-call rotation, responding to production alerts and following up with fixes or runbook updates so the same issue does not repeat.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 3-5 years in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including 2+ years working in AWS production environments. Looking for someone who has experience shipping infrastructure changes through code review. Depth matters more than the number.
  • Experience operating a multi-tenant SaaS platform at scale, including participating in a 24/7 on-call rotation.
  • A degree is not required. Demonstrated hands-on experience counts equally.

Technical depth

  • Deep AWS knowledge across compute, networking, and security services, such as EC2, ECS/Fargate, Lambda, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudFront, and RDS.
  • Strong Terraform understanding, including module design, state management, and pull-request-based CI/CD workflows. You can read a plan and explain what will be created, changed, or destroyed, and where the risk is.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals: least-privilege IAM, encryption in transit and at rest, network security groups and WAFs, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and logging tools and building actionable alerts.
  • Experience administering relational and NoSQL databases in production.
  • Solid Linux and container (Docker) fundamentals.
  • Able to read and reason about code and scripts in Python, Go, Bash, or Node.js/TypeScript, including large JavaScript/TypeScript codebases when tracing infrastructure-related bugs. You do not need to write them from scratch.

How you work with AI

  • Daily, practical use of AI tools like Claude, with the judgment to critically review AI-generated scripts, Terraform, and IAM policies, and accountability for everything you ship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, or ISO 27001, including evidence collection and control implementation.
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud or other regulated or isolated environments.
  • A security certification or equivalent depth, such as AWS Certified Security - Specialty, CompTIA Security+, or CCSP, or experience with SIEM, intrusion detection, or threat modeling.
  • Experience running AI/LLM infrastructure, such as Amazon Bedrock, LLM gateways, vector databases, or MCP servers.
  • Experience governing AI agent access to cloud environments, including scoped IAM roles, session logging, and approval workflows.
  • Familiarity with GitOps tooling for Terraform and CI/CD platforms such as CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodeBuild.
  • Experience with data warehouses and pipelines (for example, Redshift and ETL tooling).
  • Kubernetes/EKS experience.
  • Experience at a small or early-stage company where you wore many hats.

 

Interviews will be recorded and transcribed by an AI notetaking tool so our team can focus on the conversation and review it accurately later. Notes are used only for evaluating your application. You can opt out at any time by letting your recruiter know.

 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/knack-cloud-engineer-1

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

 

About the Job

We are seeking a high-impact relationship builder to own and grow OpenTable's most strategic hotel partnerships worldwide. As the Global Hotel Partnerships Manager, you will be the primary architect of OpenTable's relationships with the world's leading hotel brands and management groups — sitting at the critical intersection of business development, product evolution, and global operations.

You will manage a portfolio of high-value, Tier-1 hotel partnerships, leading complex global negotiations, driving adoption of OpenTable's technology suite, and ensuring our products are seamlessly integrated into the world's most prestigious hotel portfolios. Success in this role means growing revenue and retention through a consultative, data-driven approach while serving as the connective tissue between partner executives, their technical teams, and OpenTable's internal functions.

This is a remote position, with a preference for candidates based on the East Coast. The role requires up to 25% domestic and international travel. 

Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary relationship owner for Tier-1 global hotel partners (e.g., Marriott, Hilton, Four Seasons, IHG), overseeing relationship health, retention, and revenue growth across regions.
  • Lead end-to-end negotiation and contracting for global service agreements, co-marketing contracts, and technical addendums, structuring terms that maximize strategic value across diverse markets.
  • Develop and execute profitability and revenue strategies that exceed growth and retention goals — including auditing financial structures such as rebate programs and implementing pricing models that increase average partner revenue.
  • Drive global adoption of high-value features and products, including OpenTable Pro, Private Dining Instant Booking, and Automated Guest Codes.
  • Serve as the bridge between partner technical teams and OpenTable Engineering to deploy API products (e.g., Sync, CRM, Booking), and navigate enterprise-level security audits, SSO implementation, SOC 2 reporting, and complex data privacy requirements.
  • Build consensus across cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Sales Ops) to align contract terms, product requests, and account plans, and provide end-to-end support for product releases and the subsequent go-to-market strategy.
  • Prepare and lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and "Year in Review" performance audits for C-suite stakeholders, and design sales enablement and training materials that equip leadership and account management with hotel expertise.
  • Represent OpenTable at major industry trade shows and conferences, presenting on topics meaningful to the global travel and hospitality industry.
  • Own the administrative side of the partnership, including documentation of client engagement in Salesforce, stewardship of hotel-specific resource sites, and strategic communication flows.
  • The role requires up to 25% domestic and international travel. 

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in account management, strategic partnerships, or business development, ideally within the hospitality or travel technology sector.
  • Proven track record of owning and growing a portfolio of high-value accounts or partners against pre-set objectives.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, with the ability to cultivate internal and external stakeholders at the Executive and VP levels.
  • Technical literacy: comfort discussing API infrastructure, data mapping, and system integrations fluently with engineering teams.
  • Strong analytical rigor, using data to build business cases and resolve technical or business roadblocks.
  • Self-starter who is comfortable taking full ownership in an unstructured, forward-thinking environment, with strong time management and comfort handling administrative tasks.
  • College degree required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Global mindset, with experience working within and representing a global organization across multiple time zones and cultures.
  • Deep industry knowledge of the hospitality and hotel-technology ecosystem.
  • Experience navigating ambiguous legal and financial structures and complex, multi-stakeholder procurement processes.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce, Google Suite, and Microsoft Office.
  • This is a remote position, with a preference for candidates based on the East Coast. 

 

Benefits and Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to Headspace
    • Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
  • Paid parental leave
  • Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
  • Travel Discounts
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Competitive retirement and health plans

Note for MA applicants: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this United States located role is $110,000 - $130,000 USD.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits. This role is eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.

 

Work Environment & Flexibility

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.

Inclusion

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.

If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.

Company Description

WiseTech Global is a leading developer and provider of innovative software solutions for the logistics, global trade and supply chain industries worldwide. We serve more than 22,000 logistics companies across 193 countries, 23 of the 25 largest global freight forwarders worldwide. With the acquisition of e2open, we have expanded our network to encompass over 500,000 connected enterprises across manufacturing, logistics, channels and distribution. With the vision to be the operating system for global trade and logistics, we are creating a multi-sided marketplace connecting carriers, logistics providers, importers, exporters and shippers.

Job Description

A Pivotal Moment — Why Join E2open Now

In August 2025 WiseTech Global, developer of the world's leading logistics execution software CargoWise, completed its strategic acquisition of e2open. This acquisition represents one of the most significant strategic moves in global supply chain technology in recent years, and it creates an extraordinary moment to join this business.

WiseTech's CargoWise platform has historically focused on logistics service providers such as freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers. The e2open acquisition brings a deep, complementary product suite and customer base on the other side of the supply chain: the buyers, importers, exporters, shippers, manufacturers and brand owners who generate the freight in the first place.

Together, the two businesses create something that has never existed before: a truly end-to-end, multi-sided global trade and logistics marketplace connecting demand, planning, supply, channel, transportation and execution in one ecosystem, all underpinned by AI and data at scale.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and driven Area Sales Director to join our growing US sales organization. Each Area Sales Director owns a portfolio of approximately 20-30 enterprise accounts within our CPG business unit.

This role sits at the intersection of sales and professional services, with our most successful team members acting as strategic consultants and trusted advisors to our clients to help drive wider adoption of our existing product suite. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery.

What You'll Do

  • Build and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving cross-sell, upsell and new logo revenue.
  • Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence.
  • Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients understand the full value of e2open's platform and keeping satisfaction high.
  • Create and maintain detailed account plans and close plans at the opportunity level.
  • Partner with Solutions Consulting, Legal, Professional Services and other internal teams to progress and close deals.
  • Accurately maintain Salesforce CRM and report on pipeline, activities and performance metrics.
  • Represent e2open at industry events to stay current on market trends and generate new business opportunities.

Salary: $100,000-$150,000 Base + Uncapped Commission

Qualifications

What You'll Bring

  • 8–10+ years in supply chain and logistics, whether in consulting, operations, solution architecture, or enterprise B2B SaaS sales (exposure to S&OP, demand planning or inventory optimization in a CPG environment is highly preferred).
  • Experience selling supply chain, logistics, ERP or adjacent enterprise software.
  • Proven ability to close and manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across long sales cycles.
  • Confident presenting to C-suite and VP-level executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Consultative, value-based selling approach with genuine curiosity about customer challenges.
  • Ability to articulate technical solutions clearly in business terms.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and opportunities concurrently.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce or equivalent CRM; strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

Additional Information

When you join WiseTech, you’re joining a team of passionate problem solvers who are committed to changing the world of logistics, one innovation at a time. At the heart of WiseTech’s success lies our exceptional team of people, whose diverse talents and unwavering dedication drive the company forward. Our team’s broad mix of experiences and backgrounds is not merely a feature but a cornerstone of our vibrant and dynamic culture.

Creativity is in our DNA. We favor principles over policy, encourage open communication, and prioritize results over busywork. Our global team is united by our mission: to change the world by creating breakthrough products that enable and empower those that own and operate the supply chains of the world. Join us in shaping the future of logistics.

From time to time, WiseTech Global may use external service providers to assist us with assessing applications, including testing and background checks, on our behalf. jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: https://wisetechglobal.com

Company Description

WiseTech Global is a leading developer and provider of innovative software solutions for the logistics, global trade and supply chain industries worldwide. We serve more than 22,000 logistics companies across 193 countries, 23 of the 25 largest global freight forwarders worldwide. With the acquisition of e2open, we have expanded our network to encompass over 500,000 connected enterprises across manufacturing, logistics, channels and distribution. With the vision to be the operating system for global trade and logistics, we are creating a multi-sided marketplace connecting carriers, logistics providers, importers, exporters and shippers.

Job Description

A Pivotal Moment — Why Join E2open Now

In August 2025 WiseTech Global, developer of the world's leading logistics execution software CargoWise, completed its strategic acquisition of e2open. This acquisition represents one of the most significant strategic moves in global supply chain technology in recent years, and it creates an extraordinary moment to join this business.

WiseTech's CargoWise platform has historically focused on logistics service providers such as freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers. The e2open acquisition brings a deep, complementary product suite and customer base on the other side of the supply chain: the buyers, importers, exporters, shippers, manufacturers and brand owners who generate the freight in the first place.

Together, the two businesses create something that has never existed before: a truly end-to-end, multi-sided global trade and logistics marketplace connecting demand, planning, supply, channel, transportation and execution in one ecosystem, all underpinned by AI and data at scale.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and driven Area Sales Director to join our growing US sales organization. Each Area Sales Director owns a portfolio of approximately 20-30 enterprise accounts within our CPG business unit.

This role sits at the intersection of sales and professional services, with our most successful team members acting as strategic consultants and trusted advisors to our clients to help drive wider adoption of our existing product suite. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery.

What You'll Do

  • Build and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving cross-sell, upsell and new logo revenue.
  • Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence.
  • Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients understand the full value of e2open's platform and keeping satisfaction high.
  • Create and maintain detailed account plans and close plans at the opportunity level.
  • Partner with Solutions Consulting, Legal, Professional Services and other internal teams to progress and close deals.
  • Accurately maintain Salesforce CRM and report on pipeline, activities and performance metrics.
  • Represent e2open at industry events to stay current on market trends and generate new business opportunities.

Salary: $100,000-$150,000 Base + Uncapped Commission

Qualifications

What You'll Bring

  • 8–10+ years in supply chain and logistics, whether in consulting, operations, solution architecture, or enterprise B2B SaaS sales (exposure to S&OP, demand planning or inventory optimization in a CPG environment is highly preferred).
  • Experience selling supply chain, logistics, ERP or adjacent enterprise software.
  • Proven ability to close and manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across long sales cycles.
  • Confident presenting to C-suite and VP-level executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Consultative, value-based selling approach with genuine curiosity about customer challenges.
  • Ability to articulate technical solutions clearly in business terms.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and opportunities concurrently.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce or equivalent CRM; strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

Additional Information

When you join WiseTech, you’re joining a team of passionate problem solvers who are committed to changing the world of logistics, one innovation at a time. At the heart of WiseTech’s success lies our exceptional team of people, whose diverse talents and unwavering dedication drive the company forward. Our team’s broad mix of experiences and backgrounds is not merely a feature but a cornerstone of our vibrant and dynamic culture.

Creativity is in our DNA. We favor principles over policy, encourage open communication, and prioritize results over busywork. Our global team is united by our mission: to change the world by creating breakthrough products that enable and empower those that own and operate the supply chains of the world. Join us in shaping the future of logistics.

Before You Apply 

From time to time, WiseTech Global may use external service providers to assist us with assessing applications, including testing and background checks, on our behalf. Accordingly, by applying for this role and providing your personal information to WiseTech Global, you consent to WiseTech Global providing this information to our external service providers who are required to treat such information with strict confidentiality in line with privacy and data protection laws and regulations.

jobs.title: Semaphore: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Novi Sad
URL: https://semaphore.io/

About Semaphore

Semaphore is a remote-first software company building continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) products for engineering teams. Our customers rely on Semaphore Cloud and our self-hosted enterprise products to build, test, and deliver software securely and reliably.


We have spent years building developer infrastructure at scale. We are now using that foundation to create new products and capabilities for a world in which software is increasingly built by people working with AI coding agents.


About the role

We are looking for a senior product engineer who can take an important idea from an early, ambiguous problem to a useful product running in production.

You will work across product and engineering boundaries: understanding the user, shaping the solution, making technical decisions, building the system, and improving it based on real use. Some work will extend mature Semaphore products. Some will start as a small experiment or a new product. In either case, you will be responsible for getting to a strong outcome, not completing a predefined list of tickets.


AI coding agents are part of our daily engineering workflow. We expect you to use them fluently to explore, build, test, and ship faster. You remain accountable for the work: choosing the right problem, setting direction, making trade-offs, reviewing what is produced, and ensuring that the result is coherent, reliable, and maintainable.


This role is for someone with strong ownership, initiative, taste, and judgment. You should be comfortable moving between product questions, system design, code, infrastructure, and user experience as the work requires.

What you will own

  • Take product ideas from problem definition through design, implementation, rollout, and iteration, including experiments that may grow into standalone products.
  • Work directly with users and internal stakeholders to identify the real problem, decide what is worth building, and make pragmatic scope and architecture decisions.
  • Build across backend services, APIs, infrastructure-facing components, and focused frontend experiences, reusing proven Semaphore systems before introducing new infrastructure.
  • Use AI coding agents effectively while maintaining a high bar for correctness, security, clarity, and product quality.
  • Own the production outcome, including reliability, observability, supportability, and working within Semaphore's security and compliance requirements. Communicate decisions, progress, and risks clearly.

What we are looking for

  • A track record of independently shipping meaningful software products or major product capabilities.
  • Strong product judgment: you can identify the essential user problem, reduce unnecessary scope, and recognize when an experience is good enough to ship—or not good enough yet.
  • Strong engineering judgment across system design, implementation, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Strong backend and systems fundamentals, including APIs, asynchronous processing, service boundaries, state and lifecycle management, retries, idempotency, and failure recovery.
  • Comfort with infrastructure concepts such as virtual machines, storage, networking, authentication, secrets, containers, and cloud platforms.
  • Ability to navigate a polyglot environment. Semaphore systems include Go, Elixir, Ruby, React, and related technologies; expertise in every language is not required.
  • Enough frontend capability to build or extend focused product user experiences without depending on a separate team for every change.
  • Fluency with modern AI-assisted development: decomposing work for agents, supplying useful context, reviewing generated changes, and building verification into the workflow.
    Initiative and persistence. You make progress with incomplete information, surface risks early, and bring in other people when their input will improve the result.
  • Strong written and spoken English and experience working independently in a remote, asynchronous team.


We care more about the quality and ownership of what you have built than a specific number of years, previous title, or exact match with our stack.


Nice to have

  • Experience building developer tools, CI/CD systems, cloud platforms, or infrastructure products.
  • Hands-on experience with distributed systems and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience evolving a mature codebase while introducing a new product or architecture alongside it.
  • Experience in a lean environment where senior engineers participate directly in product discovery and customer conversations.

What success looks like

Within your first three months:

  • You have taken ownership of a meaningful product problem and shipped a useful capability to production.
  • Your work shows good product taste, clear technical decisions, and disciplined scope.
  • You have learned enough of Semaphore's existing platform to reuse its strengths and avoid unnecessary reinvention.

jobs.title: Bitovi: Backend / Platform Developer Consultant (Temporal & Kubernetes)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: https://bitovi.com

JOIN OUR TEAM!

Bitovi is looking for a Backend / Platform Developer Consultant to join us as we transform technology delivery. We build and operate durable, distributed systems for enterprise clients — heavy on Java Services, Temporal for workflow orchestration, Kafka for event streaming, and Kubernetes-native platform engineering on AWS to run it all reliably. If you want to build exceptional systems, take orchestration, systems engineering, and infrastructure seriously, and have ideas for making delivery more collaborative, validation-driven, and swift, we want to work with you!

Compensation: $120,000 to $190,000 annually, depending on experience, plus annual bonus opportunity.

PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only considering candidates located in and authorized to work in the United States.

 

WHO YOU ARE

You're experienced building and running applications at the enterprise level, and you're comfortable owning both the code and the infrastructure it runs on. You think like a systems engineer — reasoning about the whole platform, from JVM services and event streams to the clusters and cloud infrastructure underneath them. You thrive when given opportunities to deliver real-world platforms as an integral team member, including large-scale migrations, and you have the expertise to interface and communicate confidently with stakeholders.

You'll excel in this role at Bitovi if you have:

  • Strong working knowledge of Java and the JVM ecosystem (Spring Boot or similar); experience with additional backend languages (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, etc.) is a plus
  • Hands-on experience with a durable execution / workflow engine — Temporal preferred (Apache Airflow, Prefect, or similar also relevant) — including modeling workflows and activities, handling retries and timeouts, and reasoning about idempotency and failure modes
  • Experience designing and operating Kafka-based event streaming systems: topic and partition design, consumer groups, schema management, and reasoning about ordering, delivery guarantees, and consumer lag
  • Experience designing and building GraphQL APIs — schema design, resolvers, and performance concerns (N+1, caching, pagination); federation experience a plus
  • Deep, hands-on AWS experience: architecting, deploying, and operating production systems (EKS, networking, IAM, messaging, and data services)
  • Solid Kubernetes experience: deploying, operating, and debugging production workloads
  • A systems engineering mindset: understanding of complex scaling issues, concurrency, backpressure, caching strategies, and failure modes across distributed systems
  • Experience planning and executing migrations — application replatforming, workflow engine migrations, data/schema migrations, or moving workloads between environments with minimal downtime
  • A thorough understanding of CI/CD pipelines and GitOps-style delivery
  • Experience with observability in practice — logging, metrics, and tracing (OpenTelemetry a plus)
  • Experience building modern microservice-based or serverless applications
  • Database schema design and development expertise

Other skills we value

Temporal depth

  • Running Temporal in production — self-hosted on Kubernetes and/or Temporal Cloud
  • Workflow versioning and patching, safe deployments, and long-running workflow migrations
  • Worker deployment and tuning (pollers, task queues, concurrency/slot configuration)
  • Namespace management, mTLS (SPIFFE/SPIRE or private CA), and capacity/scaling concerns (e.g. APS/TRU on Temporal Cloud

Kafka & event streaming depth

  • Operating Kafka in production (MSK, Confluent, or self-managed on Kubernetes)
  • Kafka Connect, Kafka Streams, and schema registry workflows (Avro/Protobuf)
  • Migrating between clusters or providers, and integrating Kafka with downstream analytical stores
  • Experience with different techniques for processing large datasets, such as Lambda and Kappa architectures

Platform / DevOps depth

  • Building or operating an internal developer platform (IDP) — self-service, paved-path infrastructure for application teams
  • GitOps with ArgoCD (or Flux) and a low- or zero-manual-apply delivery model
  • Infrastructure as code: Terraform/OpenTofu, and provisioning AWS resources via Crossplane, ACK, or similar
  • Writing Kubernetes controllers/operators (controller-runtime, kubebuilder) and working with CRDs
  • Helm chart authoring and distribution (including OCI/registry-based)
  • Secrets management (External Secrets Operator, etc.), autoscaling (Karpenter, KEDA), and service mesh concepts (Istio, SPIFFE/SPIRE)
  • EKS or comparable managed Kubernetes at scale

General

  • Interest in working across multiple backend languages
  • Additional queueing and messaging technologies (AWS SQS/SNS, RabbitMQ)
  • API design across paradigms (GraphQL, REST, gRPC)
  • AuthN/AuthZ and related technologies (sessions, API tokens, JWTs)
  • Automated testing across the stack (unit, integration, performance/benchmarking)

WHO WE ARE

Bitovi partners with companies to build outcome-focused apps and platforms. Our collaborative approach is driven by validation to deliver the swiftest route to the most valuable solution.

We design and build high-profile applications and the infrastructure behind them — with tests, full docs, and a real deployment process. We run a serious Temporal practice (including large-scale migration and security work for enterprise clients) alongside deep Kubernetes, AWS, and platform engineering work. We discuss and design architectures, review code, and research new technologies. We talk to our clients, guiding them through the process, identifying potential problems and unknowns, and tackling challenges.

We help one another freely. We keep a Slack channel called ask-help, which is constantly used. We develop new skills, build better developer tools, and work on new types of projects regularly.

Our fully remote team comprises about 70 developers and designers. We welcome diversity and non-traditional paths into professions — we want the right person, not the right collection of tech keywords.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO AT BITOVI

Build durable systems. Design and implement Java services, Temporal workflows, and Kafka-based event pipelines, and help clients adopt durable execution and event streaming the right way — from first workflow to production scale.

Lead modernization efforts. Plan and execute large-scale modernization efforts — moving workflows, services, and data between platforms, clusters, and clouds — with safety, observability, and minimal disruption as first-class requirements.

Own the platform. Build and operate Kubernetes-native infrastructure and CI/CD on AWS so application teams can ship safely and quickly. Treat reliability, observability, and repeatability as part of the deliverable, not an afterthought.

Consult and manage. Consult with clients to build outcome-driven applications and platforms, guiding them through the process, identifying potential problems and unknowns, and tackling challenges.

Travel. This is a remote, full-time position that requires the ability to travel. We travel an average of 3–5 days every quarter, and we'll always do our best to work with your schedule.

Teach. We'll discuss opportunities for you to present at conferences, attend and give training, plan and run meetups or local groups, and create various kinds of content in your area of expertise.

 

BENEFITS WE OFFER

  • Competitive salary and annual bonus opportunity
  • Completely remote work with flexible hours
  • 401(k) matching
  • 4 weeks of paid time off in addition to 8 paid holidays
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance offerings
  • Paid maternity and paternity leave
  • STD, LTD, and Life Insurance coverage

 

HOW TO APPLY

Please share a resume or LinkedIn profile and answer the additional questions via the application link. 

 

OTHER 

Please note that we are not interested in working with recruiters. 

ID Verification required if invited to an interview.

All job offers are contingent on passing a background check. 

Candidates must be located in and authorized to work in the United States; we are unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time.

ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Principal Data Engineer to define and evolve the architecture, engineering standards, and operating model for our enterprise data platform.

This role is for a technical leader who excels at complex system design: translating business and analytical needs into scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable data products. The Principal Data Engineer will lead critical architectural decisions across data ingestion, storage, transformation, orchestration, governance, observability, and consumption, while raising the engineering bar through mentorship, design reviews, and pragmatic best practices.

You will work across engineering, analytics, platform, security, and business stakeholders to create systems that make trusted data accessible, timely, and actionable at scale.

 

What You’ll Do

Lead Data Architecture and System Design

  • Own the technical vision and architecture for scalable, resilient, and cost-effective data platforms and pipelines.
  • Design end-to-end data systems spanning batch and streaming ingestion, transformation, data modeling, storage, orchestration, serving layers, and consumption patterns.
  • Make and document high-quality architecture decisions, including tradeoffs involving performance, reliability, scalability, latency, security, maintainability, and cost.
  • Define reusable architectural patterns for common data engineering challenges, including CDC, event-driven data flows, schema evolution, slowly changing dimensions, data quality, and multi-tenant or domain-oriented data models.
  • Establish clear boundaries and interfaces between operational systems, data platforms, analytics layers, and downstream applications.
  • Lead technical design reviews for high-impact initiatives and provide clear, constructive direction on implementation approaches.
  • Identify architectural risks early and drive plans to mitigate technical debt, single points of failure, data inconsistency, and operational fragility.

Set Engineering Standards and Best Practices

  • Establish and continuously improve standards for data engineering development, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, incident response, and lifecycle management.
  • Define best practices for version-controlled data transformations, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, code review, automated testing, and environment promotion.
  • Build a culture of data reliability by implementing standards for data contracts, schema management, lineage, observability, freshness, completeness, accuracy, and reconciliation.
  • Champion security, privacy, access control, governance, retention, and compliance requirements throughout the data lifecycle.
  • Develop practical engineering guardrails that enable teams to move quickly without sacrificing quality, trust, or operational excellence.
  • Drive adoption of well-defined SLIs, SLOs, alerting, runbooks, and post-incident learning practices for critical data products.

Drive Technical Decision-Making

  • Create and maintain architecture decision records, reference architectures, roadmaps, and technical standards that provide clarity across teams.
  • Influence leaders and stakeholders through concise communication of technical options, risks, tradeoffs, and recommended paths forward.

Build and Improve Data Products

  • Lead the design and development of high-value, production-grade data pipelines, datasets, and platform capabilities.

Mentor and Multiply Engineering Excellence

  • Mentor data engineers at all levels, with a particular focus on growing senior engineers into strong technical leaders.
  • Provide practical coaching on system design, data modeling, debugging, performance tuning, code quality, and production operations.
  • Lead architecture reviews, technical workshops, design sessions, and knowledge-sharing forums.
  • Establish reusable templates, reference implementations, and playbooks that improve consistency and accelerate delivery.
  • Foster an inclusive, high-accountability engineering culture centered on thoughtful collaboration, continuous learning, and ownership.
  • Act as a technical multiplier: helping teams make better decisions independently while maintaining alignment with shared architectural principles.

 

What you bring

Required

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, platform engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years designing and operating large-scale data platforms, distributed data systems, or enterprise-grade data products.
  • Demonstrated expertise in end-to-end system design, including defining requirements, evaluating tradeoffs, designing resilient architectures, and delivering production systems.
  • Deep experience with modern data architecture concepts, such as lakehouse or warehouse platforms, batch and streaming processing, data modeling, orchestration, metadata management, and data governance.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one general-purpose programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or similar.
  • Experience with distributed data processing frameworks and technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, or equivalent platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of data modeling practices across analytical, operational, and domain-oriented use cases.
  • Experience establishing engineering standards for testing, CI/CD, observability, infrastructure as code, reliability, and security.
  • Proven ability to lead technical decisions across multiple teams without relying on direct authority.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and raising technical standards across an organization.

Preferred

  • Experience with cloud-native data platforms on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience implementing data mesh, domain-oriented data product, or self-service platform patterns.
  • Familiarity with data governance, cataloging, lineage, privacy, and access-control tooling.
  • Experience supporting financial, revenue, operational, customer, or enterprise analytics domains.
  • Experience with ML data pipelines, feature stores, or AI/LLM data foundations.
  • Experience managing major data-platform migrations, modernization programs, or large-scale architectural transformations.

Leadership Competencies

  • Systems thinker: Connects individual technical decisions to broader platform, organizational, and business outcomes.

  • Technical judgment: Makes clear recommendations amid ambiguity and communicates tradeoffs transparently.
