jobs.title: Vertican: Senior Applied AI Engineer, Document Intelligence
jobs.description:
Headquarters: New Jersey, USA
URL: https://vertican.com

About the role

For 40 years Vertican has buildt software that runs law firms. One year ago we created a new modern AI platform for document automation (processing/extraction/redacting) which our customers have been adopting faster than any product we've ever had. Our suite of AI-enabled products save customers thousands of hours each week by processing high volumes of documents with precision and speed.The AI team is growing and we'd like you to join.

We are hiring an engineer to own the document processing pipelines end to end: design, benchmarking, experimenting with new architectures and tools, threshold required for deploying a new pipeline, etc.

We believe it's important to build our own tooling to help us run, improve, and measure our applications. Therefore, the ideal candidate thinks outside the box on how to not just build the product/pipeline, but also the tooling needed around it.

You will be the first dedicated ML hire on the product taking over from the engineering manager who build the current solution and will work directly with the founding engineering team.

This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role, but we are small team and you'll be involved in design, planning, roadmapping, and architectural decisions.

What you will do

Design the pipelines. Own the architecture of the extraction-to-posting pipelines: page classification, field extraction, candidate retrieval, claim matching, confidence gating and the hand-off to human review, etc. Decide where rules end and models begin, and what each stage must guarantee to the next, what the separation of concerns are, etc.

We have different pipelines for different document types and expect that at any given point in time we may have new ones emerge and may consolidate others.

Evaluate new systems before we adopt them. Run structured trials of candidate components and recommend what to keep. Examples include probabilistic record linkage (Splink), Azure AI Content Understanding and Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI and Foundry-hosted models, and LLM agents with tools. Similarly, test new models with the existing pipeline as they are relased from the frontier labs.

Build the evaluation process. You'll own the process of evaluating false positives, false negatives, errors of ommission, etc, that we ultimately use to determine if we should upgrade the pipeline. 

Ship and operate. Take components from trial to production in our python workers on the cloud, instrument them, watch cost and quota, and diagnose the cases reviewers send back.

Set direction. Work with leadereship on the planing for accuracy, cost improvement, and overall product improvements.

What we are looking for

Required

  • 6+ years building ML or data-intensive systems, at least 3 of them owning a production pipeline whose output people acted on.
  • Solid backend engineering understanding and ideally cloud architecture understanding.
  • Ideally hands-on experience with document understanding: OCR or layout models, field extraction from scanned PDFs, or intelligent document processing products.
  • Experience with entity resolution or record linkage at scale (Splink, Dedupe, Zingg, or your own blocking-and-scoring system) against databases of hundreds of thousands of rows.
  • You have designed an evaluation from scratch: built a labeled ground-truth set, chosen the metrics, and defended a threshold to a non-technical stakeholder.
  • Production experience with LLM APIs, including structured output, tool calling and cost or rate-limit management; you can say when an LLM is the wrong tool.
  • Strong Python and SQL. Comfortable reading Postgres query plans and writing the raw query when the ORM gets in the way.
  • Engineering/Scientist mindset: you are scientific about testing the pipeline and how results are interpeted/presented.

Nice to have

  • Azure AI services (Content Understanding, Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI, Foundry) or the AWS and GCP equivalents.
  • Financial document processing: checks, remittance advices, lockbox files, payment matching, or accounts receivable automation.
  • Exposure to collections, legal operations or other regulated workflows handling PII.
  • Probabilistic matching theory (Fellegi-Sunter) or active-learning labeling workflows.
  • Experience building human-review tooling or feedback loops that feed back into training and evaluation data.

How we work and what we offer

Small team, direct access to large datasets, weekly planning, daily standup, everyone remote in US timezones.

What we offer:

  • A small team of tight-knit, like-minded people passionate about high quality software
  • Competitive compensation, commensurate with a senior individual-contributor role.
  • Monthly payments in USD

Vertican is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

About the Role

Thousands of developers and companies use Exa on pay-as-you-go. As the Support Engineer for PAYGO, you own all of their inbound questions: getting started, search quality, billing, errors, integrations, and real bugs. The volume is high and every day is different.

It's one of the fastest ways to learn Exa end to end. You'll work with our AI support tools, the docs, Product and Engineering, and you'll see what developers build with Exa before anyone else does. Some of the people writing in are tomorrow's biggest customers, and you'll be the one who spots them.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the PAYGO queue: answer what the AI first line can't, quickly and clearly

  • Debug with customers: reproduce issues with the API, read their code and send working fixes

  • Triage well: production issues and unhappy customers first, everything else in order

  • Escalate with full context: bugs to Engineering, product gaps to Product, and anything you can't resolve to the Support leader

  • Spot growth: flag PAYGO accounts that look like future enterprise customers to Sales

  • Improve the AI first line: fix the docs, help center and agent workflows so the same question doesn't need a human twice

  • Spot patterns across tickets and turn them into product feedback

Requirements

  • Programming experience: you can read unfamiliar code, call an API and debug a failing request

  • Clear, short writing. Customers can act on your answers without coming back

  • You learn fast and keep quality high when the volume is high

  • Good judgment on what to answer yourself and what to escalate

  • Comfort working AI-first, with AI tools and agents as part of your daily workflow

  • Early-career candidates are welcome

You might excel if you...

  • Have worked in support, developer relations or a customer-facing technical role at a developer-tools, API or AI company

  • Have built side projects with LLMs, RAG or agents

  • Enjoy being the person who finally figures out what's going on

  • Want to grow into an FDE or Solutions Architect role over time

  • Care deeply about the problem of organizing the world's knowledge and making it accessible to machines

This is a remote role based in the US. We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). In addition to premium healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), we also offer fertility benefits and a monthly wellness stipend to all of our employees.

CareTalk Health

CareTalk Health is a fully remote, nationwide virtual medical practice. We partner with Medicare Advantage plans to deliver Annual Wellness Visits and close care gaps, reaching members wherever they are. We believe virtual care isn't a compromise — it's care delivered the way patients actually want it. Our job is to make that experience simple, reliable, and human.

About the Role

We are seeking Patient Support Specialists (PSS) who are the first point of contact for patients in our virtual clinic and play a critical role in ensuring smooth, timely, and high-quality care delivery. The PSS is the starting point of the virtual care experience. They contact scheduled patients, confirm readiness for the visit, and seamlessly coordinate the handoff to the care team. By ensuring smooth patient flow, the PSS plays a critical role in maintaining patient satisfaction, keeping the clinical schedule on track, and delivering an exceptional virtual care experience.

We are hiring for multiple full-time positions. All opportunities are fully remote. The hours are Monday-Friday 9-6pm EST, compensated at a rate of $20 per hour. 

What You’ll Do 

Key Responsibilities

Care Team Coordination

  • Serve as the central coordinator for multiple care teams at once, ensuring patients are connected with the right clinician at the right time.
  • Drive patient engagement by keeping the flow of visits moving smoothly across several concurrent schedules.
  • Transfer patients to the appropriate care team members using call handling tools and provide real-time intake information.
  • Notify the RN when a patient is ready, track the status of each visit, and anticipate next steps to prevent delays.
  • Monitor call activity across teams and proactively support timely handoffs from RN to provider.
  • Escalate scheduling conflicts, clinical concerns, or patient-related issues promptly to protect care quality and efficiency.

Patient Intake and Check-In

  • Initiate outbound calls to scheduled patients to confirm appointments, verify identity, and ensure readiness for the visit.
  • Conduct pre-visit intake, including review of demographics, consent, and any required pre-screening questions.
  • Perform technology checks when appropriate (e.g., audio, video readiness) to prevent delays during the visit.
  • Set a professional, welcoming tone that builds trust and positions the patient for a positive care experience.
  • Take inbound calls to assist patients with questions about their visit, scheduling, or technical navigation.

Communication and Documentation

  • Maintain accurate documentation of patient outreach, intake, call routing, and handoff activities in the designated system(s).
  • Provide real-time updates to the clinical team on patient status and any scheduling adjustments.
  • Support patient satisfaction by answering questions or redirecting concerns to the appropriate resource.

Technical Navigation & Support

  • Use tools to route patients per clinical workflow.
  • Troubleshoot minor technical issues (e.g., patient audio or video) and escalate as needed.
  • Communicate with patients and care team members via internal chat or phone to coordinate activities.

Required

  • Experience in a healthcare or customer service setting required
  • Strong digital fluency and comfort with navigating multiple platforms (Zoom, Teams, EHR/CRM tools)
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and maintain calm in a fast-paced virtual environment

Preferred

  • Experience in telehealth, medical office or remote care delivery
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and patient privacy regulations
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish (or other language) is a plus

Work Location Requirement

This is a remote U.S.-based position. Employees must perform all work physically within the United States. International work is not permitted during scheduled work hours.

Work Environment 

This is a remote position and may be “on camera” at any time. The Patient Support Specialist will work from a home office, requiring reliable internet connectivity and a secure, private workspace.

 

Technical Requirements:

  • Computer:
    • Windows or Apple (macOS) Computer ONLY (NO Chromebooks, Linux Machines, or Smartphones)
    • Must have at least Windows 10 or macOS 14 Sonoma.
  • Hardware: 
    • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Equivalent (Windows); Apple Silicon (Macs)
    • RAM: 16 GB
  • Headphones: Wired headphones required for optimal audio quality. (NO built-in mics)
  • Internet Speed: Meet minimum internet speed requirements (100 MBPS download speed and 50 MBPS upload speed). Must have an ethernet cable connecting computer directly into router.
  • Browser and System: Use Google Chrome with Amazon Workspaces (regardless of computer type). 
  • Webcam: A webcam is required for video calls. Most laptops have a built-in webcam, which is acceptable. If your computer does not have a webcam, you will need to use an external webcam.
  • Recommended Equipment: A second monitor is highly suggested for laptop users; dual monitors for PC users. 

Why CareTalk Health

CareTalk Health is a fast-growing telehealth organization that delivers high-quality virtual care at scale. This role offers the opportunity to shape contractor operations, influence performance outcomes, and support innovative care models across a nationwide clinical workforce.

CareTalk Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Remote, Nationwide – Seeking Instructional Designer

 

Everybody Has A Role To Play In Transforming Healthcare

 

At Vituity you are part of a larger team that is driven by our purpose to improve lives. We are dedicated to transforming healthcare through our culture by working together to tackle healthcare’s most pressing challenges from the inside.

 

Join the Vituity Team. At Vituity we’ve cultivated an environment where passion thrives, and success comes through shared purpose. We were founded in a culture that values team accomplishments more than individual achievements, an approach we call “culture of brilliance.” Together, we leverage our strengths and experiences to make a positive impact in our local communities. We foster this through shared goals and helping our colleagues succeed, and we also understand the importance of recognition, taking the time to show appreciation and gratitude for a job well done.

 

Vituity Locations: Vituity has opportunities at 900 practices across the country, serving 14.5+ million patients a year. With Vituity, if you ever need to move, you can take your job with you.

 

The Opportunity

  • Designs and develops engaging, accessible, learner-centered learning solutions that support enterprise education, organizational initiatives, knowledge transfer, and performance.
  • Conducts learning and performance analyses to identify audience needs, desired performance, root causes, skill gaps, and appropriate learning or performance-support solutions.
  • Develops and customizes learning across modalities, including eLearning, instructor-led and virtual learning, blended programs, job aid, microlearning, simulations, assessments, video, communications, and other performance-support resources.
  • Translates complex content into clear, accurate, engaging, and learner-centered experiences through research and collaboration with SMEs and stakeholders.
  • Develops measurable learning objectives, instructional strategies, storyboards, scripts, prototypes, practice activities, assessments, and evaluation approaches aligned to intended performance outcomes.
  • Applies instructional design and adult-learning principles, learning science, usability, accessibility, content governance, brand/design standards; uses approved AI-enabled tools responsibly to support analysis, design, development, and quality assurance.
  • Conducts quality assurance and user testing to identify and resolve content, accessibility, usability, and functionality issues before implementation.
  • Creates and edits multimedia assets and refreshes, improves, or retires learning assets based on feedback, data, content changes, and business needs.
  • Shares design approaches, tools, lessons learned, and work in progress to support team learning and consistency.
  • Participates in peer reviews and provides timely, constructive, and actionable feedback; seeks and incorporates feedback on their own work.
  • Applies established instructional design standards and contributes recommendations to improve templates, guidance, workflows, and best practices.
  • Independently manages assigned learning projects, including scope, timelines, milestones, stakeholder reviews, approvals, dependencies, risks, and deliverables.
  • Balances multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining quality, responsiveness, and alignment with agreed-upon requirements.
  • Identifies opportunities to improve learning experiences, development processes, tools, templates, and team workflows.
  • Evaluates and uses approved learning technologies, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve quality, efficiency, and learner experience.
  • Contributes instructional design and digital-content expertise to pilots, cross-functional projects, technology testing, and improvement initiatives within assigned scope.
  • Partners with SMEs and stakeholders to clarify performance needs, desired outcomes, audience requirements, and project expectations.
  • Recommends appropriate learning, performance support, or non-training solutions based on identified needs and constraints.
  • Provides guidance on learning strategy, modality selection, learner experience, accessibility, and implementation considerations.
  • Communicates recommendations, tradeoffs, progress, risks, and decisions clearly to stakeholders.
  • Builds productive relationships with internal partners and represents Learning & Development professionally.
  • May manage solely, or in partnership with the LMS Administrator, including but not limited to: uploading, testing, updating, maintaining, and retiring courses and curricula in accordance with established standards and processes.
  • Troubleshoots course-level Learning Management System (LMS) issues related to functionality, navigation, tracking, completion, and learner experience; supports testing of Learning Management System (LMS) updates and features and escalate system-level issues to the Learning Management System (LMS) Administrator as appropriate.
  • Partners with the Learning Management System (LMS) Administrator and stakeholders to support learner assignments and course delivery and develops or maintains SOPs and documentation related to instructional design processes and Learning Management System (LMS) interactions as needed.

 

Required Experience and Competencies

  • Bachelor’s degree in instructional design, education, business, communications, or a related field required OR an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in instructional design or learning content development, with related experience in areas such as technical writing/editing, digital content, multimedia development, or content governance required.
  • Experience applying one or more of the following: adult-learning theory, learning science, instructional design principles, and fit-for-purpose methodologies—such as ADDIE, SAM, and backward design—throughout the learning-development lifecycle required.
  • Experience conducting learning and performance needs analyses; defining measurable learning objectives; recommending appropriate learning or performance-support solutions; and evaluating learning effectiveness required.
  • Experience designing and developing engaging, accessible learning experiences across multiple modalities, including e-learning, instructor-led or virtual instructor-led training, job aids, performance-support resources, and interactive multimedia required.
  • Experience partnering with subject-matter experts and stakeholders to gather requirements, translate complex information into clear and actionable learning content, incorporate feedback, and move projects through review and approval required.
  • Experience managing learning projects from planning through implementation, including scope, timelines, deliverables, stakeholder communication, and competing priorities required.
  • Experience working with a Learning Management System (LMS), including uploading and managing content, supporting course assignments, tracking learner completion, and assisting with course administration required.
  • Proficient in Articulate 360, including Storyline and Rise, with the ability to develop, update, test, and troubleshoot interactive digital learning content required.
  • Working knowledge of – and ability to apply – accessible and inclusive learning-design principles and applicable standards, including captions, alternative text, color contrast, keyboard accessibility, and accessible documents required.
  • Experience applying WCAG and accessibility standards to e-learning and digital learning content preferred.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud or comparable digital-media editing tools preferred.
  • Experience using learning analytics, learner feedback, assessment data, or performance data to improve learning solutions
  • Experience with learning platform reporting, course lifecycle management, or LMS quality assurance preferred.
  • Portfolio demonstrates learner-centered, accessible learning solutions across more than one modality preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of adult-learning principles, instructional design methodologies, learner-experience design, learning science, and performance-based learning.
  • Ability to analyze business, performance, and learning needs; identify root causes; determine when training is appropriate; and recommend practical learning or performance-support solutions.
  • Ability to translate complex, technical, or specialized information into clear, concise, engaging, and learner-centered content for varied audiences.
  • Ability to develop measurable learning objectives and align instructional strategies, content, practice, assessments, and evaluation methods with desired learning and performance outcomes.
  • Ability to design accessible and inclusive learning experiences by applying applicable accessibility standards and best practices across learning content and digital media.
  • Strong project-management and organizational skills, including managing multiple projects and priorities, establishing timelines, coordinating reviews, identifying risks and dependencies, communicating status, and meeting established deadlines.
  • Strong collaboration, consultation, and communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with SMEs, stakeholders, and team members; facilitate productive discussions; incorporate feedback; and communicate recommendations clearly.
  • Proficiency with LMS, multimedia, collaboration, documentation, project-management, and productivity tools, including Microsoft 365 applications such as Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint.
  • Ability to use learner feedback, assessment results, stakeholder input, and available learning and performance data to evaluate effectiveness and continuously improve learning solutions.
  • Demonstrates the judgement, validation, confidentiality, and human-review practices required for responsible use.
  • Ability to work independently with initiative and sound judgment while contributing to a collaborative team environment through knowledge sharing, peer review, constructive feedback, and continuous improvement.

 

The Community

Even when you are working remotely, you are an important part of the Vituity Community. We offer plenty of opportunities to engage with other Vitans through a variety of virtual meet-and-greets, events and seminars.

  • Monthly wellness events and programs such as yoga, HIIT classes, and more
  • Trainings to help support and advance your professional growth
  • Team building activities such as virtual scavenger hunts and holiday celebrations
  • Flexible work hours
  • Opportunities to attend Vituity community events including LGBTQ+ History, Día de los Muertos Celebration, Money Management/Money Relationship, and more

 

Benefits & Beyond*

Vituity cares about the whole you. With our comprehensive compensation and benefits package, we are mindful of what matters most, and support your needs of today and your plans for the future.

  • Superior health plan options
  • Dental, Vision, HSA/FSA, Life and AD&D coverage, and more

  • Student Loan Refinancing Discounts

  • Purpose-driven culture focused on improving the lives of our patients, communities, and employees

 

 

We are excited to share the base salary range for this position is $64,970 - $81,215, exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. This position is also eligible to participate in our annual corporate Success Sharing bonus program, which is based on the company’s annual performance. If you are hired at Vituity, your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, education, and/or experience. We believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please speak with a recruiter for more details.

 

We are unified around the common purpose of transforming healthcare to improve lives and we believe everyone has a role to play in that. When we work together across sites and specialties as an integrated healthcare team, we exceed the expectations of our patients and the hospitals and clinics we work in. If you are looking to make a difference, from clinical to corporate, Vituity is the place to do it. Come grow with us.

jobs.title: OneImaging: Cloud Systems Administrator
jobs.description:
Headquarters:
URL: https://oneimaging.com

Radiology is the second most used healthcare service, used by over 51% of the workforce annually. Despite the critical role of radiology in healthcare, the process for undergoing a medical imaging exam has remained unchanged for decades. OneImaging is solving this with a concierge approach and a premium-quality radiology network of over 5,000 vetted providers across 48 states, which also reduces imaging costs by 60-80%. Our solution helps patients and families access essential radiology services at fair prices and without surprise bills, all while delivering immediate savings and ROI for employers and payers on every exam.

The Systems Administrator owns the day-to-day administration of our SaaS and cloud vendor stack, with security and logging as the first priority. You will manage user access across every platform we use, keep audit logging and security controls configured and reviewed, write scripts to automate repetitive admin work, and act as a first responder on security incidents. You will also provide hands-on IT support to employees. This is a generalist role for someone who likes owning systems end to end: you are the person who knows how each vendor is set up, who has access to what, and where the logs live. 

What you'll do:

Vendor and SaaS administration (security and logging first)

  • Serve as the primary administrator for our SaaS and cloud platforms: tenant settings, SSO/SAML and SCIM integration, MFA enforcement, API keys, roles and permissions.
  • Configure and maintain audit logging on every platform that supports it; centralize logs where possible and make sure retention meets our compliance needs.
  • Run periodic access reviews, remove stale accounts and over-privileged roles, and keep an accurate inventory of who has admin rights where.
  • Own the security posture of each vendor: review security settings on new tools before rollout, track vendor security notices, and evaluate new vendor requests for risk.

User lifecycle and identity

  • Onboard and offboard employees and contractors across all systems the same day, driven from Rippling and Google Workspace, our identity sources of truth.
  • Manage groups, roles and licenses; keep license counts right-sized and flag waste.
  • Maintain device enrollment, MDM policies and endpoint security for company laptops.

Scripting and automation

  • Write and maintain scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) and use vendor APIs to automate provisioning, access reviews, log collection and reporting.
  • Build lightweight integrations between systems (for example, HRIS to identity provider to SaaS) so manual admin work shrinks over time.

Security incident response

  • Act as a first responder on security alerts: triage, contain (disable accounts, revoke tokens, isolate devices), gather evidence from logs, and escalate.
  • Participate in post-incident reviews and implement the fixes that come out of them.
  • Help maintain and test our incident response and business continuity runbooks.

IT support

  • Provide tier 1–2 support to employees: hardware, accounts, access, video conferencing, printers and office network.
  • Procure, image and manage laptops and peripherals; keep an asset inventory current.
  • Write and keep up internal how-to documentation so common requests become self-service.

Platforms you will administer

These are our largest software and cloud vendors by spend over the last 12 months. Deep experience with the first group is expected; the rest you will pick up on the job.

Area

Platforms

Cloud infrastructure

Amazon Web Services (IAM, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub)

Identity, HR and devices

Rippling (HRIS, SSO, device management) and Google Workspace, used together as our identity source of truth

Productivity and email

Google Workspace (admin console, Vault, security center)

Customer support and CRM

Zendesk, Salesforce, Intercom

Communications

Zoom, Aircall, Twilio

Data and engineering

Databricks, MongoDB Atlas, Sentry, Linear, Postman, Stytch

AI platforms

Anthropic, OpenAI (API key and usage management)

Collaboration and design

Notion, Lucid, Figma, Adobe, Scribe

Security tools

NordVPN Teams, Virtru (email encryption)

Healthcare operations

Waystar, AdvancedMD

Marketing and recruiting

Braze, ActiveCampaign, Greenhouse, LinkedIn

About you:

  • 3+ years administering SaaS and cloud platforms in a company of 50–500 people, including Google Workspace and an identity/HR platform like Rippling or Okta, and ideally AWS.
  • Hands-on experience configuring SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, MFA policies and role-based access.
  • Working knowledge of audit logging and log review: you know what a CloudTrail event, a Workspace audit log or a Zendesk audit entry looks like and what to do with it.
  • Scripting ability in at least one of Python, PowerShell or Bash, and comfort calling REST APIs.
  • Experience responding to security incidents (phishing, compromised accounts, lost devices) and documenting what happened.
  • Strong IT support instincts: you communicate clearly with non-technical colleagues and close tickets fast.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA or a comparable compliance framework (SOC 2, ISO 27001) and what it means for access control and logging.

Nice to have:

  • AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, Security Specialty, or Google Workspace Administrator certification.
  • Experience with a SIEM or log aggregation tool (Datadog, Splunk, Google SecOps, or similar) and writing detection rules.
  • MDM experience (Rippling, Jamf, Kandji, Intune) and macOS/Windows endpoint hardening.
  • Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code for managing AWS and SaaS configuration.
  • Prior work in a healthcare or other regulated company.
  • Experience administering API usage and keys for AI platforms (Anthropic, OpenAI) and setting spend and access controls.

The base salary range for this position is $60,000 - $75,000. Individual compensation will depend on various factors, including qualifications, skills, experience, location, and applicable laws. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive and competitive benefits plans.

jobs.title: Mindrift: Licensed Physician (MD/DO) - Freelance AI Trainer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Singapore
URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/r7muFeAbcksMFWASJu45jA/jobs-at-mindrift

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What this opportunity involves

We’re looking for US-based, actively practicing physicians (MD/DO) to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation program. General and internal medicine are our main focus. While each project involves unique tasks, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;
  • Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you’re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, join us!

What we look for 

This opportunity is a good fit for US-based physicians open to part-time, non-permanent projects. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified with the issuing medical board);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with recent direct patient care (attending-level preferred);
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This opportunity is not fit to medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

Project time expectations 

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted. 

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $100/hr. Because payment is per approved task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

About the Role

As a Freelance Marketo Email Specialist, you'll build, test, and launch email programs in Marketo for a range of client brands. This is a hands-on, execution-only contract role with no leadership or management responsibilities. You'll take approved briefs and turn them into working programs, building responsive templates and modules, setting up smart lists and flows, and making sure every send goes out right the first time. You know Marketo well enough to spot a broken token, a misfired trigger, or a segmentation gap before it reaches a subscriber. You'll take direction from our internal team, get up to speed fast, and deliver accurate builds on schedule with minimal oversight.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and launch email programs in Marketo, including one-off sends, nurture streams, engagement programs, and triggered campaigns.
  • Develop and maintain responsive email templates and modular components in HTML and CSS, using Marketo's template syntax, variables, and editable sections.
  • Set up smart lists, smart campaigns, flow steps, and segmentations that match the targeting and logic in the brief.
  • Use tokens, dynamic content, and snippets to personalize emails and keep programs easy to clone and reuse.
  • QA every email before launch: rendering across clients and devices (e.g. Litmus or Email on Acid), links, tokens, personalization fallbacks, and list logic.
  • Manage program structure, naming conventions, and folder organization so client instances stay clean and easy to navigate.
  • Build to the brief and requirements provided, and flag any gaps or errors in the request before they become problems in the send.
  • Communicate status, timelines, and blockers clearly with your internal point of contact.
  • Document builds and processes so other team members can pick up, update, or reuse the work.
  • Follow established Marketo, deliverability, and accessibility standards on every build.

Qualifications

Required

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience building and deploying email campaigns in Marketo Engage.
  • Strong working knowledge of Marketo programs, smart lists, smart campaigns, tokens, snippets, and dynamic content.
  • Proficiency in HTML and CSS for email, including responsive and hybrid coding and Marketo template syntax.
  • Experience with email rendering and QA tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid.
  • A detail-oriented QA process that catches errors in logic, links, and personalization before launch.
  • Experience working across multiple clients or Marketo instances, adapting quickly to different setups and conventions.
  • Clear, proactive communication, including flagging risks early and giving accurate time estimates.
  • Ability to work independently, take direction well, and hit deadlines across overlapping requests.

Preferred

  • Marketo Certified Expert or Marketo Certified Associate.
  • Familiarity with email deliverability, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and list hygiene.
  • Experience with email accessibility standards (e.g. WCAG).
  • Experience with lead scoring, lifecycle programs, and Marketo–Salesforce CRM sync.
  • Experience with other marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze).
  • Agency or consulting experience.

Why Current

At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

We're a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

You'll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and technologies, and contribute to meaningful digital experiences within a growing agency environment.

This is a freelance, contract engagement. The target hourly rate for this role is $50 - $70 per hour. Actual rate is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

jobs.description:

Overview

We are building evaluation benchmarks that test whether AI agents can complete real professional work from start to finish. We are hiring expert mechanical design and CAD automation engineers to turn real, paid CAD tasks from their own work into expert-level Terminal-Bench challenges. Each task includes the files and systems it runs on, a working solution and a check that proves the result is correct.

***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***

Responsibilities

• Design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks by turning real, paid mechanical CAD work from your own experience into challenges an AI agent must solve end to end.

• Define each task precisely, including the files, systems and environment it runs on, so an AI agent can attempt it without ambiguity or hidden assumptions.

• Write a working reference solution using scripted CAD, such as FreeCAD or CadQuery Python, that rebuilds parametric parts correctly after parameters change.

• Build automated checks and tests that prove the result is objectively correct, covering geometry, dimensions, tolerances and file outputs such as STEP or IGES.

• Calibrate difficulty so each task takes an expert about 60-75 minutes to solve, and explain how a real-world mistake would be caught by the checks.

• Iterate on tasks based on reviewer feedback, documenting the design intent, tools, data and rules used so others can reproduce and validate your work.

Skills/Experience

• 3+ years designing real mechanical parts that were manufactured or shipped, doing the hands-on work yourself (not only studying, selling, managing or teaching it)

• Hands-on CAD work within the last 3 years, with the ability to name the systems, tools, data and rules you used

• Builds or modifies designs through scripts (FreeCAD or CadQuery Python, OpenSCAD, Onshape FeatureScript), not only through GUI work

• Reads engineering drawings, tolerances and GD&T, and can explain how a design mistake would be caught

• Technical fluency with Python or another language and the command line, plus files such as CSV/JSON, APIs or databases

• Availability to start around early November 2026 and take on tasks on a flexible, task-based schedule

Nice-to-have

• Parametric design-intent experience

• Open-source hardware contributions or projects

• Docker and Git experience

• Experience writing automated tests

• Experience with SolidWorks, Fusion or Onshape APIs and STEP/IGES workflows

Process

• Task-based vetting: you complete a vetting task instead of an interview

• Paid per task, with each task taking about 60-75 minutes to solve

• Flexible, task-based work cadence, with an expected start around early November 2026

Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

The Role

In the Value Realization Office at Kyndryl, you will play a critical role in ensuring that our customers achieve and maximize the tangible business outcomes promised in their digital transformation journeys. You will act as the strategic driver behind establishing, measuring, and protecting value across complex IT outsourcing, enterprise resource planning (ERP), and large-scale infrastructure engagements post-contract signature.


In this role, you will define and execute the VRO operating model from the ground up, establishing governance cadences, RACI frameworks, and executive escalation paths tailored to each engagement. You will partner closely with client finance and operations leaders to rigorously construct and validate operational baselines, translating overarching deal cases into transparent, actionable benefits registers equipped with defined KPIs, milestones, and auditable proof points.


Your financial acumen and analytical rigor will be central to defining robust measurement models for hard cost savings, risk and cost avoidance, productivity uplift, and service quality enhancements. By designing automated scorecards and dashboards, tracking realized gains, and diagnosing root causes behind value leakage or process drift, you will keep critical customer engagements on course. Furthermore, you will lead high-impact value reviews with C-suite stakeholders and Kyndryl account executives, turning proven realized value into a catalyst for account renewals, expansion, and long-term client advocacy.


Key Responsibilities

  • VRO Governance & Operating Model: Establish and lead the VRO governance framework across major IT outsourcing and transformation accounts, including meeting cadences, RACI matrices, roles, and escalation workflows.
  • Baseline Validation & Benefits Architecture: Partner directly with client finance and operational teams to construct baseline metrics; convert complex deal value propositions into operational benefits registers with designated owners, timing, and verifiable evidence standards.
  • Value Modeling & Auditable Tracking: Define rigorous measurement methodologies for hard savings, cost avoidance, operational productivity, and service quality; maintain financial models (TCO, ROI, payback periods) and establish auditable evidence trails for formal sign-offs.
  • Executive Reviews & Leakage Mitigation: Facilitate monthly and quarterly value realization reviews with C-level client executives and Kyndryl leadership; identify root causes of value leakage (e.g., scope creep, process drift, delayed adoption) and enforce recovery action plans.
  • Analytics & Tooling: Build dynamic value dashboards and scorecards using Power BI or equivalent platforms to deliver single-pane visibility into target versus realized gains.
  • Cross-Functional Synergy & Practice Growth: Collaborate with delivery and Organizational Change Management (OCM) leads to tie workforce adoption metrics to benefit realization; coach VRO analysts and package frameworks into standardized practice IP.


Your Future at Kyndryl

Kyndryl’s mission to modernize enterprise IT and drive business transformation means that within the Value Realization Office, you will be positioned at the vital intersection of technology, finance, and client strategy. You will lead high-profile transformation initiatives, mentor and direct VRO analysts across concurrent engagements, and actively contribute to building reusable assets, benchmark repositories, and measurement standards that scale across our global practice.

Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID-19 vaccination policies.  Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.

Who You Are

You bring a growth mindset, navigating complex transformation headwinds with clarity and decisive problem-solving. You are relentlessly customer-focused—committed to ensuring our clients see verifiable return on investment and financial transparency. Finally, you are empathetic, collaborative, and borderless, partnering seamlessly across organizational change management (OCM), delivery, and executive teams to build trust and achieve shared success.

Who we're looking for

Ethena is growing fast, and we need a finance leader who’s excited to build what comes next. As our Head of Finance, you’ll own the full finance function, from accounting and close to forecasting, planning, and board reporting. You’ll report to our COO and work closely with them to give our leadership team the data and insight behind our biggest decisions. You’ll also give every department head a clear line of sight into their budget. We’re looking for someone with a real point of view. You’ll be hands-on in the details one day and zoomed out on strategy the next. Along the way, you’ll build a high-performing finance team that holds itself to a high bar.

What you’ll do

You’ll also pull together and synthesize the data behind our biggest calls. You’ll flag risks and opportunities early, lay out the levers we can pull, and bring a recommendation on things like a smarter way to deploy spend or a cost that’s growing faster than its value. Then you’ll turn it into takeaways the exec team can act on.

Partner Discovery & Requirements Analysis

  • Produce gap-analysis documentation mapping current-state processes and partner requirements to existing platform capabilities.
  • Classify requirements based on appropriate disposition, such as existing functionality, configuration, new development, acceptable operational workaround, shared platform enhancement, or out of scope.
  • Maintain a consistent backlog structure across implementations so requirements remain comparable, traceable, and reusable.

System Reconciliation & Technical Analysis

  • Analyze application logic, SQL, stored procedures, configuration parameters, integrations, and data flows to understand existing system behavior.
  • Determine whether business requirements can be satisfied through configuration, existing functionality, process changes, or new development.
  • Validate assumptions about platform behavior against available technical evidence and distinguish confirmed system behavior from inferred behavior.
  • Identify discrepancies between documented behavior, stakeholder expectations, system configuration, and implemented logic.
  • Trace business rules to underlying parameters, data elements, calculations, integrations, and system components.
  • Identify where behaviors are configurable versus hardcoded and assess the impact on future implementations.

Requirements Authoring

  • Write clear business and functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies, open questions, and proposed workarounds.
  • Maintain appropriate separation between business-facing requirements and technical implementation details.
  • Ensure acceptance criteria reflect the agreed solution approach, including configuration changes, operational workarounds, or new functionality.
  • Apply a consistent standard for distinguishing standalone requirements from assumptions, configuration decisions, implementation details, or operational procedures.
  • Maintain traceability from business need through solution decision and development implementation.

Cross-Functional Facilitation & Governance

  • Facilitate requirements, solutioning, and review sessions across business, clinical, product, engineering, data, and operational teams.
  • Drive open questions toward resolution and update requirements and documentation to reflect confirmed decisions.
  • Identify ambiguity, conflicting requirements, downstream impacts, and cross-feature dependencies before development begins.
  • Prevent scope drift and ensure implementation-specific requirements do not unintentionally become platform-wide requirements.
  • Support prioritization and decision-making by clearly communicating business impact, implementation complexity, dependencies, and risk.

Ticket Creation & Scoping

  • Translate approved requirements into development-ready tickets containing problem statements, user stories, functional scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, assumptions, and open questions.
  • Partner with engineering and architecture teams to clarify technical scope and implementation approach.
  • Track dependencies across features, integrations, implementations, and shared platform capabilities.
  • Identify common capabilities that can support multiple clients, workflows, or future implementations rather than creating one-off solutions.
  • 8+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Product Manager, Product Owner, or equivalent role in a software-, data-, or technology-driven environment.
  • Experience working within healthcare technology, healthcare operations, payer/provider systems, pharmacy, claims, revenue cycle, eligibility, or related healthcare domains.

  • Strong analytical rigor with the ability to distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions, challenge unclear reasoning, and validate conclusions.
  • Experience facilitating requirements and solution-review sessions involving business, clinical, operational, and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt business and technical information for different audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Healthcare workflow analysis
  • Technical and data analysis
  • System behavior reconciliation
  • Product and backlog management
  • Stakeholder facilitation and decision-driving
  • Cross-functional collaboration

BetterHelp is a technology-enabled mental health marketplace that connects patients with therapists and psychiatric providers covered by their insurance plans. By bringing patients, providers, and insurers together, we aim to remove barriers to care and help more people find the right support for their needs.

Why Join BetterHelp

  • Competitive earning potential: Estimated effective hourly earnings of $119–$242 per hour*, based on modeled assumptions for a 60-minute period that may include patient visits and applicable CPT codes.
  • Expand access to mental healthcare: Provide psychiatric care to individuals who may otherwise face barriers to finding an available provider who accepts their insurance.
  • Deliver collaborative care: Work alongside BetterHelp’s network of licensed therapists to provide thoughtful, evidence-based treatment.
  • Spend more time on patient care: BetterHelp supports credentialing, payer enrollment, and platform operations so you can focus on your patients.
  • Work from anywhere: Deliver care 100% remotely through BetterHelp’s telemedicine platform.
  • Build a schedule that works for you: This is a flexible, part-time 1099 contract opportunity.

What You’ll Do

You’ll provide compassionate, evidence-based psychiatric care in a convenient virtual setting including:

  • Conduct video consultations and communicate with patients through telemedicine.
  • Assess, screen, diagnose, and prescribe medication when clinically appropriate.
  • Develop individualized treatment plans based on each patient’s needs.
  • Coordinate treatment planning and care delivery with BetterHelp’s network of licensed therapists.
  • Deliver empathetic, high-quality care while upholding BetterHelp’s clinical and service standards.
  • Share feedback with BetterHelp’s product, engineering, and operations teams to help improve the provider and patient experience.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re looking for psychiatrists who are passionate about expanding access to mental healthcare and comfortable delivering high-quality care virtually.

You’ll be a strong fit if you have:

  • At least one year of experience as a licensed Psychiatrist.
  • An active medical license (MD/DO) in good standing.
  • Experience prescribing medication when clinically appropriate and permitted by applicable state law.
  • Confidence using technology and online tools to deliver virtual care.
  • Strong communication skills and a patient-centered approach.

Even better if you have:

  • Previous telemedicine experience.
  • Active medical licenses in multiple states.
  • Fluency in additional languages.

Important to Know

  • This is a part-time, independent contractor (1099) position, not a salaried employee role.
  • BetterHelp will support credentialing and enrollment with multiple health plans to help expand access to insured patients.
  • All patient care is delivered remotely through BetterHelp’s telehealth platform.

License/Certification

Location

jobs.description:
Headquarters:
URL: http://formhealth.co

Form Health is a virtual obesity medicine clinic delivering multi-disciplinary evidence-based obesity treatment through telemedicine. Obesity impacts more than 40% of the US adult population, and although historically only about 1% of patients received medical treatment for their disease, the field of Obesity Medicine is entering a period of rapid growth. Form Health provides high-quality expert care and leverages technology to enhance the patient experience. All Form Health patients work closely with their care team, which includes board certified physicians, advanced practice professionals and Registered Dietitians. Through our proprietary mobile app patients engage in regular video visits, as well as text messaging, photo journaling, digital data transmission, and customized educational materials. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of clinical care, and to treating every individual with empathy and respect. 

Founded in 2019, Form Health is a venture-backed innovative startup with an experienced clinical and leadership team. Our mission is to empower patients and be leaders in Obesity Medicine driving impact at a national scale. We are deeply invested in our core value to put patients first, and also deeply committed to creating a culture where every employee is valued and we learn and improve together.

 

About the Role:

We are seeking Physicians specialized in Endocrinology and Obesity Medicine to join our innovative, multidisciplinary chronic disease management team. A valid medical license to practice and prescribe legally in any US state is required, and eligibility to obtain additional state licenses as needed is required.

This role is designed for an American Board of Internal Medicine (ABIM) certified Endocrinologist with demonstrated expertise in obesity medicine, comprehensive diabetes management, and a strong interest in working collaboratively with Endocrine Advanced Practice Providers (APPs) in providing high-quality patient care.

A critical aspect of this role is ensuring the safe and effective management of patients with complex co-morbidities, including Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD), End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD), and Cardiovascular conditions. The physician will help enhance the consistency, safety, and effectiveness of patient care across the team, specifically integrating the use of Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs) and insulin pump therapy.

This is a fully remote W-2 position (US-based), with flexible scheduling options: 32 total hours per week, 36 total hours per week, or 40 total hours per week. From the total working hours, 80% will be clinical/patient-facing care, and 20% administrative time.

What You Will Do:

  • Provide direct patient care in a telemedicine clinical setting, focusing on evidence-based treatment for obesity and comprehensive diabetes management, including insulin titration and care of patients who may already be using insulin pumps and/or continuous glucose monitors (CGMs)
  • The role could involve having your own panel of patients, or collaborating with APPs and Registered Dietitians specializing in diabetes treatment, primarily Type 2 Diabetes. This role could involve APP collaboration and supervision, as needed
  • Review charts and conduct initial and return visits to ensure quality, continuity of care, and appropriate management of CKD/ESRD and CAD/CV conditions
  • Provide advanced treatment planning and medical management support for complex endocrinology cases, escalated concerns, and patients requiring specialized management protocols.
  • Prescribe non-controlled medications, including those for obesity and diabetes, for patients under both direct care and in coordination with APPs
  • Ensure clinical documentation, protocols, and treatment pathways are followed consistently within the team, with a focus on guidelines for managing complex diabetic populations
  • Assist in the professional development of colleagues by fostering clinical growth, offering feedback, and supporting continuing education in both endocrinology and obesity medicine
  • Participate in team-based care initiatives and contribute to a culture of collaboration and high-quality care
  • Attend relevant departmental meetings and contribute to quality improvement efforts within the diabetes and obesity medicine program

About You:

  • Must have an MD or DO degree
  • Required: Valid and current Board certification in Endocrinology by the American Board of Internal Medicine (ABIM)
  • Highly Preferred: Certification by the American Board of Obesity Medicine (ABOM) 
  • 2 years of clinical experience and pharmacotherapy (older generation oral and newer injectable medications) in obesity medicine or endocrinology, post residency OR completed an accredited Fellowship program in Endocrinology or Obesity Medicine, in lieu of years of experience
  • Required: Active and unrestricted Medical State License in any US State, and eligibility to obtain additional state licenses (IMLC preferred, but not required)
  • Must be currently opted-in with Medicare
  • Demonstrated competency and comfort in managing patients with complex co-morbidities, including CKD, ESRD, and CAD/CV conditions
  • Expertise in advanced diabetes management, including the use of CGMs, insulin pumps, and complex insulin regimens
  • Interest in mentoring, teaching, and collaborating with Endocrine-Specialized APPs and Registered Dietitians specializing in diabetes, as needed
  • Demonstrated experience working with APPs, medical residents, or trainees in a clinical academic setting
  • Adherence to evidence-based treatments, behavioral interventions, nutrition, and pharmacotherapy for both endocrine disorders and obesity
  • Open to working one of the following W2 roles: 32hrs/week, 36hrs/week or 40hrs/week
  • Committed to delivering patient-centered, culturally competent care
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Experience providing synchronous patient care in a telehealth setting is preferred
  • Bilingual candidates with medical fluency in Spanish are desired, but not required

Form Health’s benefits:

  • Competitive salary 
  • Comprehensive health benefits. Medical, dental, vision: from day 1
  • 401k program
  • Flexible work schedules and paid time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • Ability to participate in Form4Form, Form Health's weight loss program available to all employees and their dependents
Base Annual Salary
$210,000—$250,000 USD

Form Health’s commitment to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment:

Form Health is committed to creating a culture and environment that celebrates diversity and inclusion, while fostering safety and belonging. This extends from our remote patient care to our corporate offices and everywhere in between. We are looking for team members who want to help us further our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) efforts and who share our attitudes for creating an inclusive, safe, and positive work environment.

About Beamable 

Beamable is the backend and LiveOps infrastructure platform for game developers, the system that lets studios build, operate, and scale live games without constructing the underlying architecture themselves. Backend services, identity, analytics, meta-game systems, virtual economies, and AI-native tooling: all integrated into a single platform that eliminates the point-solution stitching that has defined game development for too long. Beamable also powers Wingman, an agentic LiveOps product that gives game teams a unified operating system to understand, optimize, and act on live game performance in real time. This is the future of how games are operated.

Beamable is part of FIRY, a founder-led global technology portfolio operating at the intersection of gaming, AI-powered performance marketing, and developer infrastructure. Acquired in January 2026, and together with Skillz, our competition platform, and RZR, our AI-driven ad network, Beamable sits at the foundation of a compounding ecosystem that no standalone competitor can replicate. If you want to build the infrastructure that games run on at a company with the vision and resources to back it — Beamable is the right place to do it.

About the Role 

Beamable is seeking a Head of Product to shape its platform vision and lead its next phase of growth in the game backend market. This is an opportunity to build the product function from the ground up, guide the platform from early access through public release, and advance AI integration to deliver meaningful value for game studios.

As the company’s senior product leader and sole product practitioner, you will own product strategy, roadmap, launch milestones, and success metrics, combining strategic direction with hands-on execution. You will work directly with studios and design partners, represent Beamable’s product vision at industry events, and translate customer insights into clear priorities. Success in this role means delivering a successful public launch, developing early-access studios into reference customers, and establishing a product foundation that drives adoption and sustained revenue growth.

Responsibilities 

  •  Product Strategy & Vision Ownership. Set the product vision for Beamable’s platform — spanning player engagement, developer tools, data enrichment, and player intelligence — and own the roadmap from early access through public release and beyond. Partner with the CRO on packaging, pricing, and tracking the studio funnel quantitatively.
  • Public Release & Launch Execution. Drive Beamable’s product through its launch milestones: early design partners, public release, and strategic partnerships. Define and own the go/no-go criteria for each milestone, ensuring the product ships when it’s ready to win.
  • Studio Partnership & Customer Discovery. Spend meaningful time every week with studios, design partners, and game developers — running discovery calls, demos, onboarding sessions, and roadmap reviews. Join sales calls and paid pilots with the CRO and turn each design partner into a reference case.
  • AI Integration & Product Intelligence. Define the guardrails, data policies, and feedback loops that make Beamable’s AI capabilities safe, effective, and trustworthy for game teams. Integrate with best-in-class tools studios already use and shape the intelligent systems that differentiate the platform.
  • Metrics Ownership & Product Function Build-Out. Define success metrics across the studio lifecycle — time to value, pilot conversion, retention, usage, and revenue per studio — and do your own analysis in SQL. Establish the product processes Beamable runs on: discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch reviews.
 
 

Key Competencies

  • Platform Product Strategy. Proven ability to set and execute product vision for a developer-facing platform, owning the strategy across multiple capability areas simultaneously — not just a feature set.
  • Customer-Facing Product Leadership. Equally credible with studio heads, producers, and engineers. Comfortable running a demo, leading a discovery call, supporting a sale, and representing the product at industry events including GDC and Gamescom.
  • Gaming Live-Ops Domain Expertise. Deep understanding of what a studio’s growth or live-ops team does day-to-day — events, offers, economies, segmentation, player support, and player data — and what slows them down.
  • AI/ML Product Judgment. Experience shipping AI or ML-driven features to production. Knows where AI adds genuine value, where it needs guardrails, and how to define data policies that serve both studio needs and platform integrity.
  • Data Fluency & Metrics Ownership. Can build dashboards, write SQL, and live with retention, churn, and revenue metrics over time. Runs experiments before big bets rather than after.
  • 0-to-1 Startup Product Leadership. Comfortable being the only PM in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment. Has built product processes from scratch and can hold the strategy and the execution at the same time.
  • Technical Depth. Conversant in data warehouses, APIs, SDKs, and system design. Can earn the respect of engineers and studio technical leads without needing a dedicated translator.

Experience 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Design, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.

  • Experience with customer engagement platforms (Braze, CleverTap), game backends (PlayFab, Nakama, Unity Gaming Services), or data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery) preferred.

jobs.title: Halcyon: Senior Backend Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: http://www.halcyon.ai

What we do:
Halcyon is the industry’s first dedicated, adaptive security platform that combines multiple proprietary advanced prevention engines along with AI models focused specifically on stopping ransomware.

Who we are:
Halcyon was formed in 2021 by a team of cyber industry veterans after battling the scourge of ransomware (and advanced threats) for years at some of the largest global security vendors. Comprised of leaders from Cylance (now Blackberry), Accuvant (now Optiv), Fireye and ISS X-Force (now IBM), Halcyon is focused on building products and solutions for mid-market and enterprise customers.

As a remote-native, completely distributed global team, we recognize great talent can exist anywhere. We invite you to apply to a job you’re interested in and we'll work a plan to meet your needs.

The Role  

  

At Halcyon, we’re building a world-class anti-ransomware platform grounded in innovation and resilience. As part of that vision, we’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our cloud team. You’ll lead the development and evolution of our data platform and API services, working within a modern tech stack that blends Scala and Rust.   

You’ll join a team focused on building scalable, maintainable backend systems that serve both internal and customer-facing functions. Your primary focus will be on Rust and Scala services, with opportunities to shape our transition to Rust where it makes sense. Python development experience is highly valued, particularly for supporting our security analysis platform which includes malware analysis engines, automated threat detection, and machine learning workflows.  

Responsibilities  

  • Lead the design and delivery of features across our data platform and public API services, including ingestion, transformation, and enrichment of security data. 
  • Drive system design, architecture, and data flow decisions in partnership with product and platform engineering. 
  • Build, deploy, and own Scala-based backend services in production, keeping them reliable, secure, and performant. 
  • Help shape and execute our migration of selected APIs from Scala to Rust, ensuring consistency and continuity along the way. 
  • Set the bar for code quality, documentation, and operational excellence.  
  • Lead design reviews, code reviews and take part in on-call and incident response. 
  • Support and enhance our Python-based security analysis platform, including malware analysis engines, automated threat detection, and machine learning model workflows.  

Skills and Qualifications  

  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with recent experience in a JVM-based codebase.  
  • A track record of designing and owning distributed systems from start to finish. 
  • Experience with Rust, or a well-formed view of when it’s the right tool, and the ability to help guide a migration. 
  • Strong understanding of APIs, messaging systems (Kafka), and modern data stores (Postgres, DynamoDB, OpenSearch).  
  • Experience building services in a cloud-native environment, preferably AWS.  
  • Working knowledge of containers and Kubernetes.  
  • Comfortable working in a remote-first, asynchronous team environment.  

Bonus Skills and Qualifications

  • Experience with Terraform, Helm, and GitHub Actions.  
  • Familiarity with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch).  
  • Prior work on security products, data pipelines, or high-availability systems.  
  • Python development experience, particularly with security analysis tools and malware detection frameworks (YARA, PE analysis, binary analysis).  
  • Familiarity with machine learning workflows, AutoML, and MLflow for model deployment and management.  
  • Experience with binary analysis libraries (LIEF, ssdeep, TLSH) and security tooling integration.

  • Parental leave.

  • Generous equity offering.

The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.​

Overview

Patchstack protects WordPress sites for hosts, agencies and developers, and we're now launching a security product for people building JavaScript apps with AI tools like Claude Code. That product is early. We have good signals from hosts and hackathons, but we haven't yet found who it serves best, what they value, or why they'll keep paying for it.

You'll be the product manager who finds that out. You'll talk to customers, use the product in real AI-assisted workflows, test ideas quickly with our designer and engineers, and build the measurement that tells us what's working. You'll work alongside two small engineering squads, a senior product designer, QA and infrastructure. You own which customer problems we invest in and how we learn from the results.

About you

You're happiest early, before the answers exist. You'd rather run a small test this week than wait for perfect data. You're comfortable in a terminal and have built things with AI-assisted tools, so you can use our product the way our customers do. You form your own view on technical claims rather than taking "it's not feasible" or "the metric improved" at face value. You say what you think, including when it's awkward, and you change your mind when the evidence says so. You work well in a flat team with little process, and you help people around you get better rather than taking work off them.

This is a fully remote job, based anywhere in Europe.

Responsibilities

  • Run customer discovery for the JavaScript product: interviews, observed usage, support and event feedback, and your own hands-on use.
  • With Growth and Product Marketing, recommend which customers and problems to focus on, backed by evidence of who uses, who pays and why.
  • Shape what we build with the Senior Product Designer from early discovery through testing. You own the problem and intended outcome; they own the design response.
  • Agree outcomes and priorities with the engineering squads and help them turn validated problems into work. Squads own delivery.
  • Build and ship small prototypes, experiments and product changes yourself where that's the fastest way to learn, within our review and QA process.
  • Own product measurement in PostHog: define the actions that matter, get tracking in place, and combine the numbers with customer evidence to explain what's working.
  • Keep what we've learned, decided and assumed visible in Notion so the team can make good investment calls.
  • Raise risks, gaps and decisions early, and escalate anything beyond your remit.
  • Experience as a product manager on a technical or developer-facing product, ideally pre or early product-market fit.
  • Examples of changing or stopping a product direction based on customer and technical evidence you gathered yourself.
  • Hands-on with AI-assisted development, the command line, packages and dependencies. You don't need to be a production engineer, but you need to be at home in that environment.
  • Strong customer research and data analysis skills, including building useful measurement from little reliable data.
  • Clear, direct communication with designers, engineers and leadership in a remote, low-process team.
  • €75–100k salary, depending on location and experience, plus company stock options
  • 4.5-day working week (half-day Fridays)
  • Remote-first, with reasonable overlap with EU timezones
  • 38 days' paid time off a year (including public holidays) plus 3 health days
  • Company laptop, and co-working membership or home-office equipment
  • AI tooling budget
  • Quarterly health and wellness allowance
  • Travel for conferences, events and our annual company meetup
